summary: Applies non-linear deformations including twist, bend, shear, taper, linear taper, and squash/stretch to selected geometry.

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Restrict deformation to a point or primitive group.

key_params.name: op
key_params.note: Choose twist, bend, shear, taper, linear taper, or squash/stretch.

key_params.name: roll
key_params.note: Rolloff or repeated effect distribution across bounds.

common_gotchas: Low-division geometry may appear unchanged or faceted; add subdivisions before strong bends or twists.
Strength and roll mean different things for each operation, so generated controls should label the chosen deformation clearly.
Linear Taper ignores Strength and Rolloff.
Rolloff at zero can localize the effect so tightly that Strength appears ineffective.
Moving the pivot away from the object center often gives better squash/stretch and bend control.
key_concepts: Twist SOP performs non-linear deformations including twist, bend, shear, taper, linear taper, and squash/stretch.
Primary and secondary axes define the deformation frame.
The pivot parameter sets the deformation origin and is often moved away from the object center for useful control.
Strength and rolloff have operation-specific meanings and can affect twist amount, bend extremities, shear amount, taper direction, or volume preservation.
